“Every score starts with Wikipedia pageviews: how many people are reading a title's Wikipedia pages each
day,” Television Stats explains on its website.

The company believes that Wikipedia usage “is one of the best available measures of general-public curiosity, capturing everyone
from actual searchers to fans checking facts after an episode.” [...] While Wikipedia pageviews form the basis for these lists, Television Stats says the Wikipedia “foundation” is “then built up with
additional engagement signals, each weighted by how reliably it reflects real attention.”
